event_records.description: Ingrid and Mattias begin negotiations over the December holiday schedule for the children.

ingrid.name: Ingrid
ingrid.persona_brief:
You are Ingrid.
Ingrid wants the children for the December holidays, especially for her family's large Lucia gathering. She is aware that Mattias has a deposit on a ski trip for the first week of the break. She is on speaking terms with Mattias and has a lawyer.

mattias.name: Mattias
mattias.persona_brief:
You are Mattias.
Mattias wants the children for the December holidays, particularly for the ski trip he has a deposit on for the first week of the break. He is aware of Ingrid's family's Lucia gathering. He is on speaking terms with Ingrid and has a lawyer.

resolution.question: Separated parents Ingrid and Mattias are negotiating who takes the children for the December holidays. Will they reach a written agreement before their mediator's final scheduled session in six weeks?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Ingrid and Mattias have both signed a written agreement regarding the December holiday schedule for the children before the mediator's final scheduled session on 2026-10-13T17:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
